feature_contract.goal: Reduce D3D11 driver submission overhead by deferring first-eye SRV and RTV unbind until the immediately adjacent right-eye draw replaces the bindings.
feature_contract.acceptance: Only consecutive left(0)->right(1) same nonzero extent projection pair may defer; preserve per-eye independent SRV, RTV, constant-buffer and draw. On second-eye Map/early failure explicitly unbind both resources before releasing OpenXR image. Legacy mono/menu behavior and SkyGlow/world/FFB remain unchanged.
feature_contract.runtime_metrics: Quest3/VDXR real HMD and p95/p99 CPU/GPU frame timing not measured; source + CI success does not prove FPS gain.

acceptance_results.evidence: vrhost/src/main.cpp extends RenderTo with narrowly gated deferred first-eye cleanup; vrhost/src/main_r23.cpp uses the contiguous pair helper and retains full right-eye render.
vrhost/src/main_r23.cpp explicitly nulls PS SRV and OM RTV on failed right-eye submission after deferred successful first eye.
